summary: Prefer Fractal release archives for compatibility baselines while retaining older Smalltalk archives

replay.detail: Compatibility test inputs only; no replay change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule change.

compatibility.detail: Baseline pins prefer fractal assets per target and accept either tagged asset name. The loader reads either package root, prefers bin/st3 when present, and supports bin/fractal otherwise. Legacy cache paths are unchanged; no runtime or wire contract change.
